seoTitle: Screen Pro Retractable Doors | Retractable, Motorized & Screen Repair
seoDescription: Premium custom screen doors, window screens, power screens, hurricane screens, and screen repair for homes across Kauaʻi’s North Shore, East Side, South Shore, and West Side.

hero.title: Premium screen solutions
hero.description: Locally owned installation of retractable screen doors, patio screens, and lanai enclosures, engineered for trade winds, salt air, and island living. Serving communities across all four sides of Kauaʻi.

intro.title: Kauaʻi’s complete
intro.lead: The right screen should feel like it was designed with your home, not added after the fact.
intro.description: We help Kauaʻi homeowners choose, install, and maintain the right screen system, from a single window repair to a fully motorized lanai. We specify quality aluminum, proven hardware, and systems we can service down the road.

servicesSection.title: Custom screens for doors,
servicesSection.description: Custom work for doors, windows, decks, lanais, and large architectural openings throughout our Kauaʻi service areas.

why.title: Why choose
why.description: We are Kauaʻi’s exclusive dealer for leading retractable screen and power-shade systems. For more than 25 years, we have gone the extra mile to deliver thoughtful recommendations, careful installation, and lasting local support.

reasons.title: Quality products
reasons.copy: We select proven retractable screen and shade systems that meet our standards for durability, clean design, and dependable everyday performance.

reasons.title: Personal service
reasons.copy: From the first site visit through long-term support, you work with a local team that listens carefully, communicates clearly, and stands behind the work.

reasons.title: Professional installation
reasons.copy: Every opening is measured precisely and installed with close attention to fit, finish, smooth operation, and respect for your home or business.

values.title: Reliable
values.copy: Reliability is ingrained in our company culture. Count on consistent performance, timely projects, and a steadfast commitment to your needs, giving you confidence in every door and window solution.

values.title: Family owned
values.copy: We are more than a business; we are family. Integrity, personal care, and community shape every interaction. When you choose Screen Pro, you become a valued member of our ʻohana.

values.title: OEM dealer
values.copy: As an authorized OEM dealer, we provide genuine products from leading manufacturers, pairing the latest innovations and highest-quality options with knowledgeable local craftsmanship.

feature.imageAlt: Custom-fit screen installation at a Kauaʻi home
feature.title: Custom-fit screen installation
feature.lead: They should work smoothly, look intentional, and let the breeze in without competing with your view.
feature.description: That is why we begin with an on-site consultation. We look at the opening, traffic flow, exposure, and how you use the space, then recommend the system that makes sense. No hard sell. No one-size-fits-all shortcut.

points.title: Measured precisely
points.copy: Custom fabricated for a clean fit.

points.title: Serviceable for years
points.copy: Quality parts we can maintain later.

brandsSection.title: Trusted retractable & motorized
brandsSection.description: We partner with manufacturers whose products meet our standards for performance, finish, and long-term serviceability.

area.title: Screen service across
area.description: From Hanalei and Princeville to Anahola, Kapaʻa, Līhuʻe, Kōloa, Poʻipū, Hanapēpē, Waimea, and Kekaha, we bring experienced screen installation and repair directly to your home.
